items.content_html: merge-guard is a lightweight AI dev tool that reviews code changes before they are merged. Paste in a git diff or connect a pull request, and merge-guard will generate a plain-English summary, highlight risky files, identify possible bugs, suggest tests to run, and produce a final merge-readiness report. It does not replace code review.
